knownKitIssues.reason: In carin-for-blue-button-test-kit v0.16.3 (the latest release) each ExplanationOfBenefit subtype validation test validates every EOB the kit collected against that one subtype's profile (perform_validation_test(scratch_resources[:all], ...) in generated/v2.0.0/eob_*/validation_test.rb), so a member with both professional and institutional claims fails the Inpatient-Institutional profile on EOBs that never claimed it. knownKitIssues.reason: In davinci-plan-net-test-kit v0.13.4 (the latest release) a forward-chain search takes its value from the first resource of the chained type the suite has collected that carries the chained element (find_forward_chain_value in search_test.rb), whether or not any resource of the searched type references it, and fails when the search returns nothing. The first Organization collected is the payer, which the Endpoint group's _include=Endpoint:organization search returns first, so the test searches for resources that point at the payer (or at whichever Location or Endpoint comes first), and a directory that links its practitioners, locations and services to the practices that run them returns none. disclaimers: An Inferno test kit encodes its authors’ reading of an implementation guide at one release. A pass means the API met the requirements that kit version tests, in the groups that were run, at the named source revision. It is not certification by CMS, ONC, HL7 or the Inferno project.
